y-m-62-02.title: Zingaki izipheya u-(a, b) ezenza kuqhubeke?
y-m-62-02.goal: Usebenzisa izibonelo owakha wena, qinisekisa ukuthi kunamapheya ama-coefficient angenamkhawulo, hhayi elilodwa kuphela, enza umsebenzi wezingxenye uqhubeke ku-x=1, futhi uhlulele ukuthi amapheya futhi anokwehlukaniseka ahluka kanjani.
y-m-62-02.material: Kuma-constant u-a no-b, chaza umsebenzi u-f kanje (u-x uyinombolo engempela). Uma u-x ungaphansi kuka-1, u-f(x)=x squared kanye no-a izikhathi u-x (x²+ax), futhi uma u-x ungu-1 okungenani, u-f(x)=2x+b. Ngezansi, u-a no-b bayizinto ezingaguquki ezizimele.
y-m-62-02.thinking.1: Yakha izixazululo eziningana futhi uhlole izimo
y-m-62-02.prereq.1: Isimo sokuthi umsebenzi uqhubeke ku-x=a (umkhawulo wesobunxele = umkhawulo wesokudla = inani lomsebenzi)
y-m-62-02.prereq.2: Ukwehlukanisa imisebenzi ye-polynomial (x squared, izisho zomugqa)
y-m-62-02.prereq.3: Incazelo ye-derivative (ukuthambeka kwesobunxele nesokudla kumele kulingane ukuze kwehlukaniseke)
y-m-62-02.s.s1.prompt: Zingaki izipheya u-(a, b) ezenza u-f aqhubeke ku-x=1? Ngaphambi kokuqala ukubala, khetha isahlulelo esifaneleke kakhulu.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala amanani owathola ngokufaka u-x=1 esishweni sesobunxele nesokudla ku-x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi mingaki izibalo ku-a no-b esimo sokuthi amanani amabili alingane esinika sona.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.a: Kukhona ipheya elilodwa kuphela, lapho bobabili u-a no-b banqunyiwe
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi njengoba kunokungaziwa okubili amanani anqunywa abe munye. Bala ukuthi mangaki izibalo ukuqhubeka okunika zona.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.b: U-a no-b banqunywa njengamapheya amabili ahlukile
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.b: Hlola ukuthi izisekelo zamapheya amabili zivela kuphi. Bheka ukuthi zingaki izibalo nokuthi zinedigri elini.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.c: Isisho sihlukile esikhaweni ngasinye, ngakho akukho pheya elenza kuqhubeke
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi njengoba isisho sihlukile esikhaweni ngasinye, azikwazi ukuhlanganiswa. Qhathanisa amanani ezisho ezimbili ku-x=1 ngqo.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.d: Kunesibalo esisodwa kuphela, ngakho ukukhetha u-a kunquma u-b
y-m-62-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuze kuqhubeke ku-x=1, umkhawulo wesobunxele u-1+a nenani lomsebenzi (umkhawulo wesokudla) u-2+b kumele kulingane. Kunalesi sibalo esisodwa kuphela, ngakho u-b=a−1, futhi uma ukhetha u-a ngokukhululeka, u-b unqunywa.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amapheya amathathu ahlukile u-(a, b) ezinombolo eziphelele aqhubeka ku-x=1, ngenani eliphelele luka-a elingu-4 ubuningi.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe u-a oyedwa futhi uthole inani lesisho sesobunxele ku-x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.1: Lungisa u-b ukuze alingane nenani lesisho sesokudla.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Umkhawulo wesobunxele u-1+a nomkhawulo wesokudla (inani lomsebenzi) u-2+b kuyalingana.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ku-x=1, inani lesisho sesobunxele u-1+a nenani lesisho sesokudla u-2+b alilingani.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.explain: Kuqhubeka uma u-b=a−1 usebenza. Izibonelo: (0, −1), (2, 1), (−3, −4). Uma u-a efana, u-b naye uyafana, ngakho ukubala amapheya ahlukile, u-a kumele ahluke.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwamapheya osanda kuwenza, khetha isitatimende esilungile mayelana namapheya futhi anokwehlukaniseka ku-x=1. (Ukuze kwehlukaniseke ku-x=1, ama-derivative asuka kwesobunxele nakwesokudla kumele alingane.)
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.0: Hlukanisa isisho sohlangothi lapho u-x ungaphansi kuka-1 futhi uthole inani ku-x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi likhona yini u-a owenza lilingane nokuthambeka kwesisho sesokudla.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.a: Phakathi kwamapheya aqhubekayo, kuphela ipheya u-a=0, b=−1 elehlukanisekayo
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.b: Uma iqhubeka iyehlukaniseka, ngakho wonke amapheya owenzile afanelekile
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi okuqhubekayo kusho okwehlukanisekayo. Thola ukuthambeka kwesobunxele nokwesokudla ngokuhlukile futhi uqhathanise.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.c: Uphethe ngaphandle kokuqhathanisa ukuthambeka. Bheka ukuthi likhona yini u-a lapho ukuthambeka kwesobunxele u-2+a nokwesokudla u-2 kulingana.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.d: Uma u-a ekhula, ukuthambeka kwesobunxele u-2+a nakho kuyakhula futhi kuya kude nokwesokudla u-2. Funa inani lapho ukuthambeka kulingana khona.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.explain: Ku-x=1, i-derivative yesobunxele ngu-2·1+a=2+a futhi i-derivative yesokudla ngu-2. Ukuze zilingane, u-a=0, futhi kusuka esimweni sokuqhubeka u-b=−1. Noma kuqhubeka, amapheya amaningi ayagoba ku-x=1, ngakho awehlukaniseki.

y-m-62-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esithole umkhawulo ku-x=2
y-m-62-01.topic: Ukuhlukanisa imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla nenani lomsebenzi
y-m-62-01.goal: Ngokuthola iphutha esixazululweni, qinisekisa ukuthi noma inani lomsebenzi lichaziwe ku-x=2, lihlukile enanini lomkhawulo, nokuthi uma imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla ihlukile, akukho mkhawulo.
y-m-62-01.material: Chaza umsebenzi u-f kanje (u-x uyinombolo engempela). Uma u-x ungaphansi kuka-2, u-f(x)=x+1; uma u-x=2, u-f(2)=5; uma u-x mkhulu kuno-2, u-f(x)=x squared kukhishwe 1 (x²−1). Umsebenzi u-g ngu-: uma u-x ungaphansi kuka-2, u-g(x)=x+1; uma u-x=2, u-g(2)=3; uma u-x mkhulu kuno-2, u-g(x)=x squared (x²). Umfundi wabhala isixazululo esithola umkhawulo luka-f njengoba u-x eya ku-2 njengoba kungezansi.
y-m-62-01.thinking.2: Hlulela isiphetho uma imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla ihlukile
y-m-62-01.prereq.0: Umcabango wokulandelana kwezikole: U-H2 kulo msebenzi uyizinga kuphela lobunzima ekuhlelweni kokukhiqiza futhi akusho ukuthi unikezwe noma yimuphi unyaka wesikole. Kuhloselwe abafundi abasevele bafunda izidingo ezingezansi.
y-m-62-01.prereq.1: Incazelo yomkhawulo womsebenzi (inani u-f(x) alisondela kulo njengoba u-x esondela ku-a)
y-m-62-01.prereq.2: Incazelo yophawu lomkhawulo wesobunxele nowesokudla (u-x usondela ku-a kusuka ohlangothini olungaphansi kuka-a nasohlangothini olukhulu kuno-a)
y-m-62-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa esixazululweni somfundi onezizathu eziphosile.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumugqa ngamunye, maka ukuthi inani elisetshenzisiwe lithole lapho u-x engesiyo u-2, noma inani lapho u-x=2.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isiphetho somugqa ngamunye sivela ngqo emphumeleni wokubala owedlule, nokuthi amanani asetshenzisiwe avela kuphi.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.1: Uma u-x esondela ku-2, u-x akasiyo u-2, ngakho sebenzisa u-f(x)=x+1 ohlangothini olungaphansi kuka-2 no-f(x)=x²−1 ohlangothini olukhulu.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.2: Siya ku-2 sisuka kwesobunxele: umkhawulo luka-x+1 ngu-3.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.3: Siya ku-2 sisuka kwesokudla: umkhawulo luka-x²−1 ngu-3.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.4: Imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla iyafana, ngakho umkhawulo ukhona, futhi inani lawo ngu-f(2)=5.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 5 uphosile. Emigqeni 3 no-4, imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla zombili zingu-3, ngakho umkhawulo ukhona futhi inani lawo ngu-3. Inani lomkhawulo linqunywa amanani ngenkathi u-x esondela ku-2, futhi inani lomsebenzi u-f(2)=5 ku-x=2 alingeni kuleso sibalo. Ngakho kulo msebenzi inani lomkhawulo u-3 nenani lomsebenzi u-5 kuhlukile.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.prompt: Manje bheka umsebenzi u-g. U-g(2)=3. Khetha incazelo efaneleke kakhulu mayelana nomkhawulo luka-g njengoba u-x eya ku-2.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngokuhlukile amanani u-g(x) asondela kuwo ohlangothini lapho u-x ungaphansi kuka-2 nohlangothini olukhulu.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala uqhathanise ukuthi amanani amabili ayafana yini, bese ubheka u-g(2).
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.a: Inani lomsebenzi u-g(2)=3 lilingana nomkhawulo wesobunxele u-3, ngakho inani lomkhawulo ngu-3
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.a: Unqume umkhawulo ngoba nje inani elilodwa lohlangothi lwesobunxele lilingana nenani lomsebenzi. Uhlolile inani elisondelwa kusuka kwesokudla?
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.b: Isilinganiso u-3.5 somkhawulo wesobunxele u-3 nomkhawulo wesokudla u-4 sinani lomkhawulo
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.b: Uma amanani amabili ehlukile, uthathe inani eliphakathi njengomkhawulo. Umkhawulo kumele uqoqane enanini elilodwa, ngakho phinda ubheke isimo lapho isobunxele nesokudla bese beya emanani ahlukile.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.c: U-g(2) ucaciswe njengo-3, ngakho umkhawulo ungu-3
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.c: Uthathe umkhawulo nenani lomsebenzi njengento efanayo. Khumbula ukuthi ku-f, umkhawulo u-3 nenani lomsebenzi u-5 kwakuhlukile.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.d: Umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-3 futhi owesokudla ungu-4, ahlukile, ngakho umkhawulo awukho ku-x=2
y-m-62-01.s.s2.explain: U-g usondela ku-3 kwesobunxele nasku-4 kwesokudla. Uma imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla ihlukile, khona-ke noma u-g(2) ucaciswe, umkhawulo njengoba u-x eya ku-2 awukho.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.prompt: Ku-g, noma inani lomsebenzi u-g(2) likhona, akukho mkhawulo. Usebenzisa u-g njengesibonelo, bhala emshweni owodwa noma emibili ukuthi umkhawulo nenani lomsebenzi kuhluka kanjani njengemibono.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ungasebenzisa izinombolo ezimbili osebenzisile emikhawulweni yesobunxele nesokudla luka-g njengoba zinjalo.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qala ubhale imishwana emibili eceleni komunye ngefomu elithi 'Umkhawulo yinani lapho ..., futhi inani lomsebenzi yinani ku-...'.

y-m-62-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubhale ukuthi umkhawulo yinani njengoba u-x esondela ku-2, hhayi inani ephoyintini u-x=2 uqobo?
y-m-62-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usebenzise izinombolo zemikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla luka-g (3 no-4) njengezisekelo?
y-m-62-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wagwema ukusho ukuthi umkhawulo kumele ube khona ngoba nje inani lomsebenzi likhona?
y-m-62-01.s.s3.model.0: Umkhawulo yinani u-g(x) alisondela kulo njengoba u-x esondela ku-2, futhi inani lomsebenzi u-g(2) liyinani langempela ku-x=2. Noma u-g(2)=3, umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-4, ngakho isobunxele nesokudla kuyahluka futhi akukho mkhawulo.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.model.1: Inani lomsebenzi liyinani kuleli phoyinti, futhi umkhawulo ukhona kuphela uma amanani asondelwa kusuka kwesobunxele nakwesokudla efana, ngakho ahlukile. U-g uya ku-3 kwesobunxele nasku-4 kwesokudla, ngakho noma u-g(2)=3 ukhona, umkhawulo awukho.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.model.2: Isondela ku-3 kwesobunxele nasku-4 kwesokudla, ngakho umkhawulo awukho, kodwa u-g(2)=3 ucaciswe. Umkhawulo yinani elisondelwayo futhi inani lomsebenzi liyinani kuleli phoyinti, ngakho kungase kungabi nabudlelwano komunye nomunye.

y-m-62-05.title: Zingaki izimpawu zokuthinta ezingadwetshwa kusuka kuphoyinti elingekho egophweni?
y-m-62-05.topic: Imigqa ethintayo edwetshwe kusuka kuphoyinti elingaphandle kwegophe
y-m-62-05.goal: Kulayini othintayo odwetshwe kusuka kuphoyinti elingekho egophweni, iphoyinti lokuthinta alaziwa, ngakho kumele ulithathe njengongaziwa bese umisa imibandela; qinisekisa ngesibonelo owakhela sona ukuthi kungase kube nemigqa eminingana ethintayo.
y-m-62-05.material: Kukhona igophe u-y=x² (x iyinombolo yangempela) neliphoyinti P(1, −3). Uma ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwephoyinti lokuthinta kungu-t, iphoyinti lokuthinta ngu-(t, t²), futhi i-slope yelayini elithintayo lapho ngu-2t, etholwe ngokufaka u-x=t ku-derivative 2x ye-y=x². Sifuna ukuthola u-t owenza lelayini elithintayo lidlule ephoyintini P.
y-m-62-05.thinking.0: Hlukanisa izindima zephoyinti lokuthinta nephoyinti ilayini elidlula kulo
y-m-62-05.thinking.2: Thola izixazululo eziningana bese uhlulela ukuthi zingaki
y-m-62-05.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-derivative ne-slope yelayini elithintayo
y-m-62-05.prereq.2: Isibalo selayini elithintayo (endaweni (t, f(t)) egophweni, y−f(t)=f′(t)(x−t))
y-m-62-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha indlela elungile yokubhala njengesibalo umbandela 'ilayini elithintayo endaweni yokuthinta (t, t²) lidlula ephoyintini P(1, −3)'.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.0: Esibalweni selayini elithintayo y−t²=2t(x−t), faka ukuqondanisa kwephoyinti P ezindaweni zika-x no-y.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwesibalo osifake kuso lungu-y−(ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwephoyinti lokuthinta) futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-i-slope×(x−ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwephoyinti lokuthinta).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.a: Lesi yisisho esithatha u-P njengephoyinti egophweni futhi sisebenzisa f(1)=1 endaweni yokuqondanisa kwe-y. U-P akulona iphoyinti lokuthinta.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.b: Hlola ukulandelana kuka-x−t uma ufaka u-x=1, y=−3 esibalweni selayini elithintayo y−t²=2t(x−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kumisa i-slope yelayini elithintayo ibe ngu-2. I-slope ishintsha ngendawo t yephoyinti lokuthinta.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.explain: Isibalo selayini elithintayo ngu-y−t²=2t(x−t). Uma lidlula ephoyintini P(1, −3), ukufaka u-x=1, y=−3 kunika −3−t²=2t(1−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imigqa emibili ethintayo ehlukene edlula ephoyintini P, ngamunye unikezwe ukuqondanisa kwe-x t kwephoyinti lokuthinta nesi-slope sayo m.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.0: Esibalweni se-c2, faka inani elilodwa lika-t bese ubala ukuthi ukulingana kuyagcina yini.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ungashintsha u-t bese uqhathanisa izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo, noma uhlele kabusha isibalo njengesibalo ku-t bese usixazulula.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c1: I-slope m ihlukile ku-derivative 2t endaweni yokuthinta.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Lelayini elithintayo alidluli ephoyintini P(1, −3). Hlola inani lika-y uma x=1.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuhlela kabusha −3−t²=2t(1−t) kunika t²−2t−3=0, okungukuthi, (t−3)(t+1)=0, ngakho t=3 noma t=−1. Kunemigqa emibili ethintayo: i-slope 6 (iphoyinti lokuthinta (3, 9)) ne-slope −2 (iphoyinti lokuthinta (−1, 1)).
y-m-62-05.s.s3.prompt: Qhathanisa ilayini elithintayo elidwetshwe endaweni (1, 1) egophweni nemigqa ethintayo edwetshwe kusuka kuphoyinti P(1, −3). Amaphoyinti okuthinta akuphi, kukhona imigqa ethintayo emingaki ecaleni ngalinye, futhi kungani kuyahluka? Yibhale emshweni owodwa noma emibili.
y-m-62-05.s.s3.hint.0: I-slope ku-(1, 1) ingatholakala ngokufaka u-x=1 ku-derivative ye-y=x². Hlola ukuthi leli phoyinti lisegophweni yini.

y-m-62-03.title: Uma uphawu lushintsha, singasho ukuthi kukhona impande?
y-m-62-03.goal: Hlulela ukuthi ukuqhubeka kuyisimo esidingekayo ukusebenzisa i-Intermediate Value Theorem, futhi uhlukanise ukuba khona kwempande nesitatimende sokuthi kunempande eyodwa ngqo.
y-m-62-03.material: Okwaziwa kuphela ngomsebenzi u-f ngu-f(1)=−2 no-f(3)=4. UMina wathi, "Ngakho kumele kube nogu-x phakathi kuka-1 no-3 onou-f(x)=0." UJunho wabuza, "Asazi ukuthi igrafu iyaqhubeka yini, ngakho singasho lokho ngokuqinisekile?"
y-m-62-03.thinking.0: Hlulela ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe lufinyelela esiphethweni yini
y-m-62-03.thinking.2: Sho ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ukwenza isiphetho sibe namandla
y-m-62-03.prereq.2: I-Intermediate Value Theorem: ku-f oqhubeka esikhaweni esivaliwe u-[a, b], u-f uthatha noma yiliphi inani u-k phakathi kuka-f(a) no-f(b) ku-c othile (njengoba kuqondwa abafundi abayaziyo)
y-m-62-03.s.s1.prompt: Kufanele sihlulele kanjani isitatimende sikaMina (kumele kube nogu-x phakathi kuka-1 no-3 onou-f(x)=0) kusuka kulwazi olubhalwe ngenhla kuphela?
y-m-62-03.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ungadweba igrafu edlula ku-f(1)=−2 no-f(3)=4 kodwa engadluli ku-0 nanini yini.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sho ukuthi yini okumele yenzeke kugrafu ukuze igrafu enjalo ibe nokwenzeka.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.a: U-f(1) unegethivu futhi u-f(3) uphozithivu, ngakho kumele kube nogu-munye
y-m-62-03.s.s1.r.a: Uqinisekise kusuka eqinisweni lokuthi uphawu lushintsha kuphela. Cabanga ukuthi zikhona yini imisebenzi eweqa amanani aphakathi.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.b: Uma izimpawu zika-f(1) no-f(3) zihlukile, akunakuba nempande
y-m-62-03.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe izimpawu ezihlukile njengobufakazi bokuthi akukho mpande. Cabanga ngegrafu eqhubekayo eshintsha uphawu.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.c: Ingasho ukuthi ikhona ngokuqinisekile kuphela uma u-f eyisebenzi okhulayo
y-m-62-03.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi isimo se-monotonic siyadingeka. Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma umsebenzi oqhubekayo ongakhuli ushintsha uphawu.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.d: Asikwazi ukwazi ukuthi iyaqhubeka yini, ngakho asikwazi ukuqinisekisa lutho kusuka kulolu lwazi
y-m-62-03.s.s1.explain: I-Intermediate Value Theorem ingasetshenziswa uma u-f eqhubeka esikhaweni esivaliwe. Uma singazi ukuthi iyaqhubeka, amanani angeqa u-0, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi kumele kube khona. Akudingeki ibe yisebenzi okhulayo.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.prompt: Lokhu okulandelayo yimpikiswano yomfundi oyedwa. Khetha umugqa odweba isiphetho esiweqisayo.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi imigqa 3 no-4 ngayinye isho u-'okungenani oyedwa' noma u-'oyedwa ngqo'.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba ukuthi igrafu enqamula i-x-axis iya phezulu, bese iya phansi, bese iya phezulu futhi iyenzeka yini.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.0: Umcabango: u-f uyaqhubeka esikhaweni esivaliwe u-[1, 3].
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.2: Nge-Intermediate Value Theorem, kukhona okungenani u-c oyedwa esikhaweni esivulekile u-(1, 3) onou-f(c)=0.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.3: Uphawu lushintsha kanye, ngakho igrafu inqamula i-x-axis kanye kuphela, futhi kunalo c oyedwa ngqo.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.4: Ngakho isibalo u-f(x)=0 sinempande engempela ku-(1, 3).
y-m-62-03.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 4 uyadlulela. Ngomcabango wokuqhubeka kuphela, singasho ukuthi kukhona okungenani u-c oyedwa onou-f(c)=0, kodwa asikwazi ukwazi ukuthi kunoyedwa ngqo. Isibonelo, u-f(x)=(10/3)(x−1.5)(x−2)(x−2.2) unou-f(1)=−2 no-f(3)=4 futhi uyaqhubeka, kodwa unezimpande ezintathu, u-1.5, 2, no-2.2.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.prompt: Uma ngaphezu kokuthi u-f uyaqhubeka wawazi olunye ulwazi olulodwa, ungasho ukuthi 'kunogu-x oyedwa ngqo ku-(1, 3) onou-f(x)=0'? Bhala nesizathu.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.hint.0: Sho ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lokuhamba oludingekayo ukuze igrafu inqamule i-x-axis izikhathi eziningana.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ukuthi yisiphi isakhiwo esivimbela lokho kuhamba kungenzeki.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma sazi u-f ... , khona-ke ... ngakho
y-m-62-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ulwazi olwengeziwe engilubhalile luyilwazi olusha olwehlukile ekuqhubekeni?
y-m-62-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uchaze ukuthi kungani, ngalolo lwazi, kungaba nezimpande ezimbili noma ngaphezulu?
y-m-62-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ucabange ukuthi olunye ulwazi olwengeziwe (isibonelo, ukwazi ukuthi i-quadratic) nalo luyenzeka?
y-m-62-03.s.s3.model.0: Uma sazi u-f ohlala ekhula ku-(1, 3), khona-ke uma inani lidlula ku-0 alikwazi ukuba ngu-0 futhi, ngakho kunempande eyodwa kuphela.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.model.1: Uma sazi ukuthi i-derivative u-f′(x) ihlala iphozithivu ku-(1, 3), khona-ke u-f ukhula, ngakho igrafu inqamula i-x-axis kanye kuphela futhi kunempande eyodwa ngqo.

y-m-62-04.prereq.0: Umcabango wokulandelana kwezikole: U-H2 kulo msebenzi uyizinga kuphela lobunzima ekuhlelweni kokukhiqiza futhi akusho ukuthi unikezwe noma yimuphi unyaka wesikole. Kuhloselwe abafundi abasevele bafunda izidingo ezingezansi.
y-m-62-04.title: Uma umkhawulo we-slope elinganiswe ngokulinganayo ukhona, ingabe iyahlukaniseka (differentiable)?
y-m-62-04.goal: Usebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo, qinisekisa ukuthi ngisho noma 'umkhawulo womehluko olinganayo' ukhona ku-x=a, i-derivative ayikho ngempela, bese uhlukanisa iziqondiso ezimbili zesitatimende.
y-m-62-04.material: Isimangalo sikaJinwoo: "Uma isiphumo (f(a+h)−f(a−h))/(2h) sinomkhawulo uma h iya ku-0, khona-ke f iyahlukaniseka ku-x=a." (Indlela yokufunda: f ka-a kanye no-h kususwe f ka-a kususwe h, kuhlukaniswe ngo-2h.) Idatha engezansi inikezwa isinyathelo nesinyathelo. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha umcabango wakho ngesimangalo.
y-m-62-04.thinking.0: Yazi imikhawulo yokwahlulela isitatimende esijwayelekile ngesibonelo esisodwa
y-m-62-04.thinking.2: Bheka ngokwehlukana ukuthi isiqondiso esiphambene siyagcina yini
y-m-62-04.s.s1.prompt: Ubheka idatha, khetha umcabango wakho ngesimangalo sikaJinwoo esinyathelweni ngasinye.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bhala ngegama elilodwa ukuthi idatha esanda kunikezwa iyasekela isimangalo, iyasinyakazisa, noma ikwenza ubambezele ukuhlulela.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.1: Esinyathelweni 3, bhala ngomcibisholo ukuthi isimangalo siya ngasiphi isiqondiso ('umkhawulo ukhona ⇒ iyahlukaniswa'), futhi bhala nesiqondiso esiphambene ngokwehlukana ukuqhathanisa.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Kwa-f(x)=x² no-a=1, (f(1+h)−f(1−h))/(2h) = ((1+h)²−(1−h)²)/(2h) = 4h/(2h) = 2. Lo mkhawulo ungu-2, futhi f′(1) etholwe ngencazelo nayo ingu-2.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngemva kokubona le datha, ucabanga ini ngesimangalo sikaJinwoo?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ku-x², amanani amabili afana. Kodwa isibonelo esisodwa asikwazi ukunquma isitatimende esijwayelekile, ngakho 'kungase kulunge kodwa kudinga ukuhlolwa kakhulu' kuyafaneleka.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Isibonelo esisodwa sasilungile, ngakho siqinisekisa ukuthi sigcina kuyo yonke imisebenzi
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqinisekise isitatimende esijwayelekile kusukela esibonelweni esisodwa esilungile. Ukuthi sigcina kunoma yimuphi umsebenzi kudinga ukuhlolwa ngezinye izibonelo.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kulungile kulesi sibonelo, kodwa sidinga ukuhlola kakhulu ukuthi sigcina nakwezinye imisebenzi yini
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Inani elifanayo eliphumayo liwukuhlangana, ngakho isimangalo sesivele singalungile
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uthathe ukuthi inani elifanayo eliphumayo liwukuhlangana ngaphandle kwezizathu. Iqiniso lokuthi inani elifanayo liphumile nalo luyulwazi.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Isimangalo sibonakala singase silunge, kodwa kusenesikhathi sokusiqinisekisa kusukela kulesi sibonelo kuphela
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Kwa-f(x)=|x| no-a=0, uma h ingeyona u-0, (f(h)−f(−h))/(2h) = (|h|−|−h|)/(2h) = 0. Umkhawulo walesi siphumo ungu-0.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Umkhawulo wesiphumo esilinganayo ukhona futhi ulingana no-0. Ukuthi lokhu kusho ukuthi f′(0) ikhona kumele kuhlolwe ngokwehlukana ngencazelo. Umfundi osevele azi ukuthi |x| iyagoba ku-0 angakubona lokhu njengesibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Umkhawulo u-0 ukhona, ngakho isimangalo silungile, futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi f′(0)=0
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uthathe ukuba khona komkhawulo wesiphumo njengokufana nokuba khona kwe-derivative. Ingabe uhlolile ngokuthola ama-slope ohlangothi olulodwa ngokwencazelo?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ukuhlulela isimangalo, kumele sihlole ngqo ukuthi f′(0) ikhona yini ngokwencazelo
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Igrafu ye-|x| iyagoba ku-0, ngakho sengivele ngazi ukuthi ayihlukaniseki, futhi ngiyibheka njengesibonelo esiphikisayo sesimangalo
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Umkhawulo uphume u-0, ngakho f idlula ku-x=0 ngokuthe tyaba
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uchaze ukuthi isiphumo esilinganayo singu-0 njengokuthi igrafu ithe tyaba. Khumbula isimo segrafu ye-|x|.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngencazelo, (f(h)−f(0))/h = |h|/h. Singu-1 uma h ikhulu kuno-0 futhi singu-−1 uma h incane kuno-0, ngakho umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-1 futhi umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-−1, futhi f′(0) ayikho.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje uhlulela ini ngesimangalo sikaJinwoo nesiqondiso saso esiphambene (uma f iyahlukaniseka, umkhawulo walesi siphumo esilinganayo ulingana no-f′(a))?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |x| iyisibonelo esiphikisayo, ngakho isimangalo sikaJinwoo singamanga. Ngokuphambene, uma f iyahlukaniseka ku-x=a, isiphumo esilinganayo singabonwa njengesilinganiso sezinhlanganisela ezimbili ze-slope, ngakho siya ku-f′(a). Iqiniso namanga kuyahluka ngesiqondiso.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Isimangalo silungile, futhi |x| yisihlukile esikhethekile esingashiywa
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ushiyile ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sinciphisa isimangalo. Isimangalo sisitatimende mayelana no-'wonke f'.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Isimangalo singamanga. Isiqondiso esiphambene kumele sicatshangwe ngokwehlukana
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zombili iziqondiso zingamanga, ngakho lesi siphumo asinakho ukuhlobana ne-derivative
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo esiqondisweni esisodwa sinciphisa nesinye isiqondiso. Bala ngokwehlukana ukuthi lesi siphumo siba yini uma f iyahlukaniseka.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Isimangalo singamanga (isibonelo esiphikisayo |x|). Esiqondisweni esiphambene, uma f iyahlukaniseka, singahlola ukuthi ukubona isiphumo njengesilinganiso se-(f(a+h)−f(a))/h ne-(f(a−h)−f(a))/(−h) kunika f′(a)
y-m-62-04.s.s1.reflect: Ukuzethemba kwakho esimangalweni kwahluka kanjani phakathi kokuqala (x²) nokokugcina (|x|)? 'Isibonelo besilungile' sihluka kanjani ku-'sigcina kuzo zonke izimo'?
y-m-62-04.s.s2.prompt: Phinda isimangalo sikaJinwoo kuye ngokuphelele. Sebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo ukuchaza ukuthi kungani isimangalo singagcini.
y-m-62-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ungasebenzisa kabusha imisebenzi nezinombolo ezisetshenziswe ezinyathelweni ezi-3 zedatha engenhla.
y-m-62-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngokubhala 'umkhawulo ukhona kodwa f′(0) ayikho' emshweni owodwa.

y-m-62-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise ukuthi isiqondiso esiphambene 'uma iyahlukaniseka, lo mkhawulo ungu-f′(a)' siyagcina?

y-m-62-04.s.s2.model.0: Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi iyahlukaniseka ngoba nje umkhawulo wesiphumo esilinganayo ukhona. Uma f(x)=|x| no-a=0, isiphumo sihlala singu-0, ngakho umkhawulo ungu-0, kodwa i-slope yesokudla ingu-1 neyesobunxele ingu-−1, ngakho f′(0) ayikho.
y-m-62-04.s.s2.model.1: Ngokuphambene, uma iyahlukaniseka, lo mkhawulo ulingana no-f′(a), kodwa hhayi ngenye indlela. Isibonelo, umsebenzi wevelu eliphelele uyagoba ku-0 futhi awuhlukaniseki ngoba ama-slope esobunxele nesokudla ahlukile, nokho lo mkhawulo ungu-0.

y-m-62-06.title: Ingabe i-local extremum ifana nenani eliphezulu? Ukuhlola kuze kube sekugcineni kwesikhawu
y-m-62-06.goal: Yakha isibonelo esiphikisayo esimangalweni sokuthi i-local maximum iyinani eliphezulu esikhaweni sonke esivaliwe, bese uchaza ukuthi iziphetho zesikhawu kumele nazo zibe yizikhethwa ekuqhathanisweni.
y-m-62-06.material: Cabanga ngomsebenzi f(x)=x³−3x (x cubed kususwe 3x) esikhaweni −2 ≤ x ≤ 3. U-x ane-f′(x)=3x²−3=0 ngu-−1 no-1, futhi f(−1)=2 no-f(1)=−2. UHajun uthe, "Kulesi sikhawu, inani eliphezulu le-f yi-local maximum engu-2, futhi inani elincane yi-local minimum engu-−2."

y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.c: I-local extremum ayikwazi ukuba yinani eliphezulu noma elincane, ngakho akulungile
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.c: Kukhona amacala lapho i-local extremum iyinani eliphezulu noma elincane. Uma ukhipha ama-local extrema kusukela ekuqaleni, ushiya izikhethwa.

y-m-62-06.s.s2.prompt: Njengezibonelo eziphikisayo zesimangalo sikaHajun (inani eliphezulu lingu-2), thola futhi ufake ama-x amathathu ahlukene esikhaweni −2 ≤ x ≤ 3 lapho f(x) likhulu kuno-2.

y-m-62-07.title: Kuthiwani uma isihlukanisi sisondela ku-0 kodwa umkhawulo ukhona?
y-m-62-07.topic: Imikhawulo yezingxenyana ezinesihlukanisi esiba ngu-0, nama-coefficient angakanqunywa
y-m-62-07.goal: Usebenzisa umbandela odingekayo wokuthi uma umkhawulo wengxenyana enesihlukanisi esiya ku-0 ukhona njengenani elinomkhawulo khona-ke inombolo engaphezulu nayo iya ku-0, qinisekisa ukuthi uma imibandela ingeyanele impendulo ngamapheya amaningi, futhi uma kwengezwa umbandela inqunywa ibe yinye.
y-m-62-07.material: Kuma-constant a no-b, cabanga ngomkhawulo wengxenyana (x²+ax+b)/(x−2) njengoba x iya ku-2. Isihlukanisi x−2 sisondela ku-0 njengoba x isondela ku-2. Okwamanje, konke esikwaziyo ukuthi umkhawulo walengxenyana ukhona njengenani langempela elithile.
